kind: mod-gated title overlay in the real game

one_mod.note: overlay window sized 1288x754 over the game window; the wordmark is visible above the game's own title screen

zero_mods.note: with an empty mods directory nothing is created and the game's own title screen is what the player sees

mechanism: topmost, click-through, per-pixel-alpha Win32 window (WS_EX_LAYERED|WS_EX_TRANSPARENT|WS_EX_TOPMOST|WS_EX_NOACTIVATE) owned by the game process via the proxy; 24/32-bit BMP art with brightness-derived alpha
limits: an overlay window, not a change to what the game renders; the container format is still undecoded, so the game's own art is untouched
